name: io.github.MicaelJarniac/repeaterbook
title: RepeaterBook
description: Look up amateur radio repeaters from RepeaterBook.com by location, band, and mode.

runtimeArguments.name: --from
runtimeArguments.description: The console script (repeaterbook-mcp) and the distribution (repeaterbook) have different names, and the server lives behind the 'mcp' extra.

environmentVariables.name: REPEATERBOOK_APP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Per-user RepeaterBook 'rbuapp_' API token. Required: every export needs an approved token, and the server refuses to start without it. No application registration needed - log in to your RepeaterBook account, open https://www.repeaterbook.com/user/api_apps.php, find 'RepeaterBook Python Client' (App #114), and generate a token for it.

environmentVariables.name: REPEATERBOOK_WORKING_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where the SQLite database and HTTP cache live. Created if missing; a leading '~' is expanded.

environmentVariables.name: REPEATERBOOK_APP_CONTACT
environmentVariables.description: Contact address used in the API User-Agent. Leave unset: it defaults to the address registered for App #114, and any other value returns 403 ua_mismatch. Set it only if you registered your own separate application with RepeaterBook.
